title: BatchGen: An Architecture for Scalable and Efficient Batch Inference
abstract: arXiv:2606.21712v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Batch inference has become a central mode of AI computation, yet existing inference engines still rely on execution models designed for interactive serving. When scaled to millions of sequences, batch workloads reveal two fundamental requirements: the ability to handle extreme inter- and intra-sequence load variation that emerges only at runtime, and the ability to sustain high utilization across large fleets of GPUs. Existing systems fail to meet these requirements, losing substantial fractions of achievable throughput.   We introduce a new architectural foundation for batch inference: the sequence coroutine compute model, which represents each sequence as a fine-grained, event-driven coroutine. This model exposes expressive primitives that allow the runtime to reorganize work dynamically, enabling larger expert-level batches, mitigating stragglers, reallocating work across devices, and maintaining utilization even on cost-eff

translated_title: BatchGen：一种可扩展且高效的批量推理架构
translated_abstract: 批量推理已成为AI计算的核心模式，然而现有的推理引擎仍然依赖于为交互式服务设计的执行模型。当扩展到数百万个序列时，批量工作负载暴露出两个基本需求：一是能够处理仅在运行时才会显现的序列间和序列内的极端负载变化，二是能够在大规模GPU集群上持续保持高利用率。现有系统无法满足这些需求，损失了相当大比例的可实现吞吐量。我们为批量推理引入了一种全新的架构基础：序列协程计算模型，它将每个序列表示为一个细粒度的、事件驱动的协程。该模型提供了富有表现力的原语，使运行时能够动态地重新组织工作，从而支持更大的专家级批次、缓解落后者问题、跨设备重新分配任务，即使在成本效率较低的硬件上也能保持利用率。
tldr: 该论文提出了“序列协程计算模型”这一批量推理新架构基础，将每个序列表示为细粒度的事件驱动协程，使运行时能够动态重组工作负载，从而在大规模GPU集群上实现更高的吞吐量和利用率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the sequence coroutine compute model as a new architectural foundation for batch inference, representing each sequence as a fine-grained, event-driven coroutine that enables the runtime to dynamically reorganize work, achieving higher throughput and utilization across large-scale GPU fleets.
